clips.title: 九成CEO推进AI：仅9%看到真转型，回报周期拉长后谁先撑不住？
title_lines: 回报周期拉长后谁先撑不住？
title_highlights: 回报周期拉长后谁先撑不住？

subtitles.en: Joining us right now is the U.S. Chair and CEO of KPMG Tim Walsh. Tim, great to see you here.
subtitles.zh: 现在加入我们的是毕马威美国主席兼首席执行官蒂姆·沃尔什。蒂姆，很高兴见到你。
en_highlights: U.S. Chair and CEO of KPMG

subtitles.en: Great to see you as well, remain. I'm basically talking like 90% of the CEOs out there are basically pushing into AI in some form or another.
subtitles.zh: 也很高兴见到你，雷曼。我基本上在说，90%的首席执行官都在以某种形式推进人工智能。

subtitles.en: So they clearly understand the importance of it.
subtitles.zh: 所以他们显然明白其重要性。

subtitles.en: There's still a lot of questions as to what the return is on that.
subtitles.zh: 关于回报是什么，仍有很多问题。

subtitles.en: I think the number that I saw in your survey was about 9% said, at least as of right now, I've seen some sort of real transformation by it.
subtitles.zh: 我想我在你的调查中看到的数字是大约9%的人说，至少到目前为止，我已经看到了某种真正的转型。

subtitles.en: That's a huge gap. Huge gap. But I assume they wouldn't be investing this much if they didn't think that gap was going to narrow.
subtitles.zh: 这是一个巨大的差距。巨大的差距。但我假设，如果他们不认为这个差距会缩小，他们就不会投入这么多。

subtitles.en: So so interesting, your intro there just in terms of the blackstone and comments, right?
subtitles.zh: 所以很有趣，你的开场白就提到了黑石和评论，对吧？

subtitles.en: Which really lines to the survey results that we're seeing is a result that it's not that CEOs are investing and companies aren't going all in.
subtitles.zh: 这确实与我们看到的调查结果一致，即不是首席执行官在**而公司没有全力投入。

subtitles.en: But the time to ROI is definitely, let's say changing or the expectation, right?
subtitles.zh: 但获得回报的时间肯定在变化，或者说预期在变化，对吧？

subtitles.en: As we learn more about how to deploy AI into businesses, which is not plug-and-play.
subtitles.zh: 随着我们更多地了解如何将人工智能部署到业务中，这并不是即插即用的。

subtitles.en: This requires process redesign AI and data cleanup.
subtitles.zh: 这需要流程重新设计、AI和数据清理。

subtitles.en: And then of course for engineering the AI into the businesses. So we feel confident as CEOs that the return will come,
subtitles.zh: 然后将AI融入业务中。作为CEO，我们相信回报会到来，

subtitles.en: but there's a required investment in timeline to get there. What are they sort of, are they worried at all about the money that is being spent and whether it is being spent prudently?
subtitles.zh: 但需要投入和时间才能实现。他们是否担心资金投入以及是否审慎使用？

subtitles.en: I mean, because when you hear from these people where they come on my show or they're in their surveys, long term, they all seem to be singing from the same him and all.
subtitles.zh: 因为当这些人上我的节目或参与调查时，长期来看，他们似乎都异口同声。
en_highlights: singing from the same him and all

subtitles.en: But there was sort of this early stage, I think of this AI and cycle, where there was just a lot of cash being thrown at the wall to see what sticks.
subtitles.zh: 但在AI周期的早期阶段，大量资金被投入，看看哪些能成功。
en_highlights: cash being thrown at the wall

clip_research.source_claim: About 90% of CEOs are pushing into AI in some form, but only about 9% say they have seen real transformation from it, and the time to ROI is changing because AI deployment is not plug-and-play.
clip_research.public_baseline: KPMG's 2025 Global CEO Outlook reports 71% of CEOs are backing AI investment, and KPMG's AI Pulse surveys report nearly 6 in 10 leaders seeing measurable business value from AI initiatives.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript's ~9% real-transformation figure is far below KPMG's own public AI Pulse finding that nearly 6 in 10 leaders report measurable business value, suggesting a gap between broad AI adoption and realized transformation.

evidence.fact: Tim Walsh says roughly 90% of CEOs are pushing into AI and about 9% report real transformation.

evidence.fact: KPMG 2025 Global CEO Outlook says 71% of CEOs are strongly backing AI investment.

evidence.query: KPMG 2025 CEO survey AI investment ROI 9% transformation
evidence.fact: KPMG AI Quarterly Pulse Survey says nearly 6 in 10 leaders report measurable business value from AI initiatives.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim KPMG officially reported that only 9% of CEOs have seen real AI transformation; the public KPMG AI Pulse survey reports a much higher measurable-value figure.
Do not claim Tim Walsh said companies are not investing in AI; he said they are investing heavily.
Do not claim Blackstone made a specific statement about AI ROI; the transcript only references Blackstone comments in passing.

notes: No reliable established Simplified Chinese personal name was found for Tim Walsh; title should keep the English name or lead with the topic.
The 9% figure is spoken by Tim Walsh in the clip but was not confirmed by the provided public snippets; treat it as a transcript claim, not an official KPMG statistic.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
